paper_metadata.title: Heterogeneous structure and dual precipitates induced excellent strength-ductility combination in CoCrNiTi0.1 medium entropy alloy

evidence.quote: In this study, through severe deformation followed by heat treatment at temperatures in the range of 700 – 900 ◦ C, we successfully obtained a fully recrystallized structure with double precipitates in non-equiatomic CoCrNiTi0.1.

The CoCrNiTi0.1 MEA with a nominal composition was fabricated through vacuum melting using a mixture of constituent metal elements (purity > 99.95 wt%) under an argon atmosphere with Zr-gettered material. Electromagnetic stirring was employed, and the melting process was repeated 6 times to ensure a homogenous composition.
Subsequently, the alloy underwent multiple passes of rolling in a two-high mill, reducing its thickness to 8 mm.
A solid solution treatment was then carried out at 1200 ◦ C for 2 h.
Following this, the alloy was subjected to further rolling passes until achieving a thickness of 1.6 mm, representing a final deformation of 80 %.
